A newline-only inline wrapper still separates the words on either side

```typescript title="WebAssembly"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown-wasm";
function main() {
  const result = convert("Alpha<span style=\"white-space:pre\">\n</span>13");
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
